title: Safe
statementMd:
Vasya tries to break in a safe. He knows that a code consists of $*n*$ numbers, and every number is a 0 or a 1. Vasya has made $*m*$ attempts to enter the code. After each attempt the system told him in how many position stand the right numbers. It is not said in which positions the wrong numbers stand. Vasya has been so unlucky that he hasn’t entered the code where would be more than 5 correct numbers. Now Vasya is completely bewildered: he thinks there’s a mistake in the system and it is self-contradictory. Help Vasya — calculate how many possible code variants are left that do not contradict the previous system responses.

## Input

The first input line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($6 ≤ *n* ≤ 35, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10$) which represent the number of numbers in the code and the number of attempts made by Vasya. Then follow $*m*$ lines, each containing space-separated $*s*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$ which correspondingly indicate Vasya’s attempt (a line containing $*n*$ numbers which are 0 or 1) and the system’s response (an integer from 0 to 5 inclusively).

## Output

Print the single number which indicates how many possible code variants that do not contradict the $*m*$ system responses are left.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 试图打开一个保险箱。他知道密码由 $*n*$ 个数字组成，每个数字都是 0 或 1。Vasya 已经尝试输入了 $*m*$ 次密码。每次尝试后，系统都会告诉他有多少个位置上的数字是正确的，但不会告诉他错误的数字位于哪些位置。Vasya 非常不走运：他输入的密码中，正确数字的数量从未超过 5 个。现在 Vasya 完全困惑了：他认为系统出了问题，给出的信息彼此矛盾。请帮助 Vasya 计算还剩下多少种不与系统之前的回答矛盾的可能密码。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$6 ≤ *n* ≤ 35, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10$），分别表示密码中的数字个数以及 Vasya 尝试的次数。接下来有 $*m*$ 行，每行包含以空格分隔的 $*s*_{*i}$ 和 $*c*_{*i}$，分别表示 Vasya 输入的密码（一个由 $*n*$ 个 0 或 1 组成的字符串）以及系统的回答（一个范围为 0 到 5（含）的整数）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示不与系统的 $*m*$ 次回答矛盾的可能密码数量。
